releaseNotes: 🚀 Official Production Release (V1.0.5 - Build 68)
📋 Smart Queue Management: Long-press any song across Home shelves, Search, Library, Playlists, Albums, Artists, and Local Music for instant contextual actions.
⏭️ Deterministic Play Next & Add to Queue: 'Play Next' inserts immediately following the active song with strict LIFO priority; 'Add to Queue' safely appends at the queue tail.
✨ Duplicate Queue Resilience: Instance-unique queue identities prevent UI crashes when adding identical songs to the queue multiple times.

🏠 Reliable Home Tab Reset: Tapping Home on the bottom navigation bar always cleanly resets to the root Home screen from any nested screen (Settings, Equalizer, Profile, Albums, Artists) without interrupting playback.
⬇️ Real-Time Download Status: Seamlessly integrated TrackDownloadManager directly into song contextual sheets with live download progress.

releaseNotes: 🚀 Official Windows Desktop Production Release (V1.0.4 - Build 67)
🛡️ Hardened Windows Release Pipeline & Inno Setup Packaging with AppUserModelID identity integration
📦 Added Zero-Install Standalone Portable Package (LofiQ-v1.0.4-Windows-Portable.zip) with MotW unblock instructions
🎵 True Dual-Player Gapless & Equal-Power Crossfade Architecture via media_kit & libmpv
⚡ Early ~10s Silent Preloading with readiness verification and bounded demuxer readahead
♾️ Zero-Overlap Gapless Playback (0s) with EOF race fix and smooth pause/resume mid-transition
🎛️ 10-Band Graphic Equalizer, Bass Boost & Spatial Virtualizer synchronized across both slots
⌨️ Windows System Media Transport Controls (SMTC), Hardware Media Keys & LRCLIB Lyrics
